title: JsonUI attribute semantics — observable cross-platform contract
notes: Hand-authored canonical rulings (semantic-drift track 33, established 2026-08-03). Each adjudicated attribute-semantics ruling is declared ONCE here; the 'observable' block states the cross-platform effect expectation that `jui conformance gate --cross-effect` verifies mechanically against every platform's control-diff verdicts (expectation values: 'uniformly-inert' = the fixture must render identically to its control on every in-scope platform; 'uniformly-active' = it must differ on every in-scope platform). Toolchain code comments must POINT here instead of restating the rule — comment canon rots (the border ruling reversed direction twice within 48 hours while living as comments in three toolchains). Canonical choices are design decisions, not majority votes of existing implementations. Add one entry per ruling as the cross-effect adjudication queue is consumed.

border.ruling: A border is drawn only when BOTH borderWidth and borderColor are declared; borderWidth alone renders nothing on every platform — there is no default border color (2026-08-03 user ruling; supersedes the transient gray-default direction of d2c8628, unified across toolchains in 3e87b96). borderStyle alone likewise renders nothing: it styles a border the width+color pair requests, it never summons one (2026-08-03 user ruling #2). NOTE: TextField.borderStyle is a DIFFERENT attribute (UIKit text-field chrome: roundedRect/line/bezel/none) and is outside this entry.

image.ruling: 2026-08-03 user rulings: (a) the default contentMode is fit on every platform — web's implicit cover default was drift; (b) fill is the stretch (scaleToFill synonym) — AspectFill is the crop. Observable consequences: a fit-valued fixture equals the default rendering and must be uniformly inert; fill/scaleToFill fixtures must differ from the fit default on every platform. Current violations are the fix queue: sjui drops fill/scaleToFill to fit (SwiftJsonUI toContentMode + sjui map_content_mode, rides 32), and web artifacts predate the rjui default/fill fix — both clear at the next re-measure.

textView.flexibleHeight: declared height is the growth floor
textView.ruling: 2026-08-03 user ruling (31 handoff): with flexible enabled, the declared height is the floor the view GROWS from — it never shrinks below it to follow smaller content. android's behavior is canonical; ios (both paths) shrank with content and must adopt the floor formula min = minHeight ?? height ?? default (rides 32). web measures 'has effect' — verify it matches floor semantics before recording it anywhere. No activeness observable: at fixture content size a correct floor renders identically to the control (that is WHY the android control_diff entry was removed in e78af64); the mechanical check belongs to the Phase 3 geometry layer.

size.ruling: 2026-08-03 user ruling (31 handoff): matchParent + maxWidth/maxHeight resolves to min(parent extent, bound) — the bound clamps the fill. Generated code is canonical (kjui emits the constraint before the fill since 847fb56); KJUI dynamic ordered fillMaxWidth before widthIn, ignoring the bound entirely — reordered in the 33 wave (bounds precede a fill, stay after an explicit size). The composite clamp fixtures below are the observable: a clamping platform renders visibly narrower/shorter than its filled control (active); ignoring the bound renders identically (inert).

networkImage.ruling: 2026-08-03 user ruling: with no src, NetworkImage displays defaultImage; while loading it displays the first of hint/placeholder/loadingImage; on error it displays errorImage, falling back to defaultImage. The conformance fixtures declare no src, so every state-image fixture must render exactly what the control (defaultImage) renders — uniformly inert. android currently violates: DynamicNetworkImageComponent parses defaultImage but never reads it, so the control is blank (KotlinJsonUI fix rides 32). NOTE: the fixtures currently reuse one asset for all state images; when the distinct-asset fixture improvement lands, revisit these expectations together with it.
